name: p3-tlc-tcommit
cmd: set -euo pipefail; python3 research/verify-all/tlc-audit-run-20261109.py tcommit 1200000 > "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/audit.log" 2>&1; cp -r runs/verify-all/tlc-evidence-tcommit-* "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/evidence"; python3 -c 'import json,sys; r=json.load(open(sys.argv[1])); t=r["tlc"]; p=r["port"]["result"]; b=r["broken"]["result"]; print(json.dumps(r)); assert t["exit"] == 0 and t["complete"] and not t["violated"]; assert r["port"]["exit"] == 0 and p["done"] and p["bad"] == 0; assert (t["states"],t["edges"]) == (p["states"],p["edges"]); assert r["broken"]["exit"] == 0 and b["bad"] > 0' "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/evidence/result.json"

cmd: bun install --frozen-lockfile && bun test research/bapa/p3-sized.test.ts && bunx tsc -p research/bapa/tsconfig.p3.json && bunx oxlint --deny-warnings research/bapa/p3-sized.test.ts research/protocols/ic3syn/models.ts && bunx @commitlint/cli --config research/egraph/historical/commitlint.config.cjs < research/bapa/P3-PORT-COMMIT.txt
